description: Confirms that the t2i task routes prompt finalization to dreamina-prompt-text2image, takes model/ratio/resolution only from live discovery, saves a free t2i draft, and hands the paid quote-confirm-run chain and download to their owner skills.
expectations: Prompts not yet finalized are handed off to dreamina-prompt-text2image; user text is never silently rewritten
Model / ratio / resolution / count values come only from the live discovery payload
Draft save uses node create image --mode t2i and never adds --run
t2i drafts carry no image / Element / resource references
Paid execution is handed off to dreamina-canvas-cli; this Skill never passes --credit-ceiling or --credit-token
Exit 20 / 21 continue via operation wait with the same submitId; a new submitId is never minted
Legacy v1.4.18 tokens (--model_version, --resolution_type, --generate_num, --poll) are never reused
The sunset notice points users away from the legacy dreamina text2image binary
